ads.text_ne:
Vacancy Announcement
Right4Children, an organization committedly involved in the areas of child protection, education and livelihood development in Pokhara and other parts of the country, is looking for a dynamic, qualified and experienced individual for the position of Business to Youth /Placement Officer, a Pokhara based position. Business to Youth /Placement Officer will be responsible for obtaining on the job experiential and employment opportunities for our beneficiaries and counsel, prepare and enhance potential of trainees in the job market.
Key Responsibilities: Identification and assessment of hosting (On the job training) companies and employers through regular meetings with employers. Pro-actively contact businesses and industries to develop partnerships and maintain interpersonal relationships with them. Ensure placements for On the Job Training and employment of the beneficiaries. Provide subsequent job support and life-skill training to our trainees (e.g. job coaching, workplace conflict resolution and counselling support) and an open channel of communication between the beneficiaries and the employer. Stay up to date with any new openings and opportunities, schedule and follow up on student interviews with prospective employers. Negotiate fair salaries and contract benefits with the employers according to the norms & standards set by the government in the specific job-related salary scales. Maintain up to date data of the beneficiaries in the data collection mobile application. Regular monitoring of trainees and employers and their performances. Report against the target on a regular basis and submit to the PC.
Required Qualification and Experience: Bachelor's degree in Management preferably in Marketing/ Business Administration/ Human Resource/ Hospitality & Service or any other relevant discipline. Two-year work experience in job development and marketing required, as well as previous work experience building employer relations in the hospitality sector. Well informed of labor market trends, employer needs and best practices in career services. Familiar with social media platforms. Computer proficiency required. Excellent presentation, networking and communication skills. Collaborative and team oriented working style. Responds positively to critical feedback and differing points of view. Ability and experience to interact and support a diverse group in a positive, friendly, and welcoming manner.
Salary for the position will be based on the organization policy.
Interested candidates are requested to email their application along with their recent Curriculum Vitae to info@right4children.org before 5 pm, 14 August, 2019.
Phone inquiries will not be entertained and could lead to disqualification.
